name: Canvas Area
description: Infinite 2D canvas surface managing floating PluginCard instances. Handles pan (mouse drag on empty space), zoom (mouse wheel), card creation (terminal/explorer/git/markdown/specsmap), card lifecycle (add/remove/minimize/reopen/focus), state serialization for persistence, auto-arrange/tile layout algorithms, grid snapping at 28px, and the plugin list panel (lower-left hover) and arrange panel (lower-right hover). Maintains z-order, world bounds clamping, and per-card plugin references.

dependencies.usage: Generates and applies SVG dot/grid pattern as canvas background image with zoom/pan alignment
Updates status bar with zoom level, lock state, workspace name, and view-all/reset buttons
Creates PluginCard instances for each plugin; manages card DOM, drag, resize, minimize, and terminate
Instantiates TerminalPlugin inside card bodies for PTY terminal emulation
Instantiates MonacoEditorPlugin via ExplorerPlugin for code editing
Instantiates ExplorerPlugin (file tree + editor split) inside explorer cards
Instantiates GitPlugin inside git cards for version control UI
Opens context menus for card header right-click and plugin list items
Instantiates MarkdownPlugin inside markdown cards for .md file preview
Instantiates SpecsMapPlugin inside specsmap cards for dependency graph visualization
